name: Mapping blocks processing when required columns are missing

planSteps.description: Navigate to the upload page: http://127.0.0.1:8501/upload

Set the file input to a file named 'minimal.csv' whose UTF-8 content is exactly:
Name,Value
Acme,100
Beta,200
Click the primary button 'Continue to column mapping →'.
A warning appears containing 'Missing required columns' and the names order_id, date, customer, region and revenue.
The button 'Confirm mapping & continue →' is present but disabled (processing cannot continue).
